title: Maintenance > "Send logs by email" is not fetching recent .zip files
body:
AAPS 3.3.1.3-dev
Build: 87110e8eeb-2025.02.05
Engineering mode enabled 

When doing exports of logs from Maintenance it seem that wrong files are being fetched. Instead of 4 latest it's picking latest .log and 3 .zip files further down in the past that isn't relevant.

Also naming has changed or just me? :) "00_00" is in all file names, I think this was earlier something about which hour.

See example:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1f0a0f9-f8c7-4a91-83c1-a407d2d31806)

comments.body:
Last dev

![Screenshot_20250218_202722_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f2a74bc-c0ff-4c48-987f-231f04f60d8f)

Exported logs by mail at 5:30AM (yep, some sleep problems...) and they contain the 2 last files from yesterday and the 2 first files of the day + the most recent log file.  My setting is _send 5 logs_

![Screenshot_20250221_092816_File Manager +.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d97d556-a084-4ba1-9428-8c5c388cbcfb)

The file numbers in the main zip seems logical to me.

On my phone i export only 3 zip files but I don't think it matters. If you open the .zip files, you can see that they belong to a different time period than when exported.

My AndroidAPS.log is from now, around 22:00
But the zip-files contains logs from around 03:00 - 05:00 last night.
it works like expected for me
Just tested this on my test-rig, latest dev with no issues. Closing. This issue was on my master-rig, but probably phone spesific
